instructions:
1. Attach a single handle to a low pulley. Stand side-on to the machine and grasp the handle with the far hand so the cable crosses in front of your body.
2. Bend at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor. Keep your knees slightly bent and your back flat.
3. Let the working arm hang straight down toward the cable.
4. Raise the handle out to the side until your hand reaches shoulder level, keeping a slight bend in the elbow.
5. Lower the handle slowly back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and under control through the full range.
2. Lead with the elbow and turn the pinky up at the top to bias the rear delt.
3. Keep the torso still and avoid swinging or using momentum.
4. Brace your core to keep the bent-over position stable.
name: Cable bent over one arm lateral raise

instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a low pulley. Face the machine and grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend at the hips until your torso is near 90 degrees, knees slightly bent and back flat.
3. Let your arms extend with the cable holding the bar.
4. Pull the bar to your lower abdomen, driving your elbows back and down.
5. Extend the arms slowly back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat and chest up throughout.
2. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.
3. Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
4. Avoid jerking the weight with the lower back.
name: Cable bent over reverse grip row

instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a low pulley. Face the machine and grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Bend at the hips until your torso is near 90 degrees, knees slightly bent and back flat.
3. Let your arms extend with the cable holding the bar.
4. Pull the bar to your lower abdomen, driving your elbows back.
5. Extend the arms slowly back to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat and chest up throughout.
2. Exhale as you pull, inhale as you lower.
3. Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
4. Avoid using momentum from the lower back.
name: Cable bent over row

instructions:
1. Attach an EZ-bar to a low pulley. Stand facing the machine and grasp the bar with a semi-supinated underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
2. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, back straight and core braced.
3. Hold the bar at arm's length in front of your thighs.
4. Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending the elbows, keeping the upper arms still.
5. Lower the bar slowly until the arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the biceps hard at the top.
2. Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.
3. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
4. Control the negative instead of dropping the weight.
name: Cable biceps curl (EZ bar)

instructions:
1. Attach a straight bar to a low pulley. Stand facing the machine and grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands closer than shoulder-width.
2. Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, back straight and core braced.
3. Hold the bar at arm's length in front of your thighs.
4. Curl the bar toward your shoulders by bending the elbows, keeping the upper arms still.
5. Lower the bar slowly until the arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the biceps at the top of each rep.
2. Keep the wrists neutral to avoid strain.
3. Keep your elbows close to your torso.
4. Move under control and avoid swinging.
name: Cable close grip curl
